name: bitrevorder
expr: [Y8, I8] = bitrevorder(x); [Yx, Ix] = bitrevorder(X); [Y4, I4] = bitrevorder([100 200 300 400]);
comment: Sig: [Y, I] = bitrevorder(X). Bit-reversed permutation; 2nd output is the 1-based index vector such that Y(k) = X(I(k)). Bug fix 2026-05-08: 2nd output was missing (probe threw 'Undefined function or variable I'). Now both outputs match MATLAB exactly. tol=0 (integer-stable).
